children: VANCOUVER, October 26, 2026 – TheNewswire – China Gold International Resources Corp. Ltd. (TSX: CGG; HKEX: 2099) (“China Gold International Resources” or the “Company”) reports that operations at its Jiama Copper-Gold Polymetallic Mine (the “Jiama Mine”) have not been affected by the earthquake in Tibet Autonomous Region. The Company reaffirms its annual production guidance for the Jiama Mine and believes the mine is well positioned to meet that guidance.

According to the official measurement by the Tibet Earthquake Network and news release of Earthquake Agency of Tibet Autonomous Region, at 22:33 Beijing time on October 22, 2026, a 7.0-magnitude earthquake occurred in Baqing County, Nagqu City, Tibet (North Latitude 32.40°, East Longitude 93.79°), with a hypocenter depth of 10 kilometers.

The earthquake occurred approximately 350 kilometers from the Jiama Mine in Maizhokunggar County.  Following the earthquake, the Company immediately implemented precautionary safety protocols across all mining areas at the Jiama Mine. Mining and processing operations have continued normally, with no disruption to production.

Based on production performance to date and operating plans for the remainder of the year, the Company reaffirms its 2026 annual production guidance for the Jiama Mine, as announced on January 27, 2026, and believes the mine is well positioned to meet that guidance.

The Company’s subsidiary, Tibet Huatailong Mining Development Co., Ltd., which operates the Jiama Mine, has donated RMB 10 million to support earthquake relief efforts in the affected areas, reflecting the Company’s commitment to supporting local communities in times of need.

The Jiama Mine has maintained safe, stable, and efficient operations, with production continuing to ramp up during the year. Its strong output is a key contributor to the Company’s production outlook.

With operations at Jiama Mine confirmed as normal and the strong production performance outlook expected, the Company continues to monitor regional conditions closely and will advise the market of any material changes to its operations or guidance.

China Gold International Resources is a gold and base metal mining company incorporated in BC, Canada and operates two mines, the Chang Shan Hao Gold Mine in Inner Mongolia, China and the Jiama Copper-Gold Polymetallic Mine in Tibet, China. The Company’s objective is to build shareholder value through growing production at its current mining operations, expanding its resource base, and acquiring and developing new projects internationally. The Company is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: CGG) and the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (HKEX: 2099).

For further information on the Company, please refer to SEDAR’s website at www.sedar.com, The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited’s website at www.hkex.com.hk, the Company's website at www.chinagoldintl.com, or call the Company at +1-604-609-0598 and email to info@chinagoldintl.com.
